method.alignment: Fixed stream delay; no per-channel shift or gain fit.
method.binaural: Same HRTF model and renderer for reference and both codecs.

zimtohrli.excluded_channels: LFE and reference RMS below -100 dBFS
zimtohrli.direction: Lower distance is better; higher mapped MOS is better.

visqol.alignment: Default internal alignment and SPL matching.
visqol.excluded_channels: LFE and reference RMS below -100 dBFS

method.reference: Render of the original unclustered object scene.
method.eac3_joc_decode: Official decoder object PCM with metadata from the same bitstream.
method.speaker_renderer: Same renderer for reference and both codecs.
method.programme_calibration: Warp mode 3, explicitly set for reference and salsa-spatial.

lfe_sweep.mode: Low-delay mono Opus, unconstrained VBR; other packets fixed.
lfe_sweep.filter_control: Reference filtered with the fixed libopus 3 Hz dc_reject response; no fitted coefficients.

spectral_method.aggregation: Mean absolute log-magnitude error in reference-active cells, then arithmetic channel mean.
